ModMetaData.name: Props as Deco
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Props as Deco connects decorative objects to Knick Knacks (surfaces) and Colonists' Deco (walls). Every integration is an optional XML patch on the source mod's own defs: nothing is copied from any source, and each batch loads only when its source mod is active.
Chinese Traditional Cultural Things Expanded: its decorative incense burner is registered with Knick Knacks so colonists can place it on tables. The def and texture stay in that mod.
Surface tags are inert without Knick Knacks; wall patches are guarded by Colonists' Deco.
